From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: Root cause and remediation — NameID attribute mismatch (Greenridge)

Folks —

Investigated with Identity. Root cause: Greenridge IdP is emitting the NameID as the 'userPrincipalName' attribute while our Coupa tenant binding expects the NameID to be sent as 'mail' (and the NameID format to be emailAddress). The result is Coupa rejects the assertion because the NameID doesn't normalize to a valid email; that matches the assertion dump Elena provided.

Proposed remediation steps:
- Short term (manual): Partner Ops to create vendor record tied to elena.morales@greenridge-industries.com so AP can raise the PO today. I'll handle the manual upload of their W-9 and initial PO routing. (Need Partner Ops acceptance by 16:30 PDT.)
- Mid term (config): Ask Greenridge IdP admin to adjust NameID format to emailAddress or map the NameID to the 'mail' attribute; OR we can add a NameID normalization rule in the Coupa tenant mapping. Either works — Karhtik, can you advise which is lower risk for us?
- Follow-up: I'll open Jira SUP-4321 to track the tenant mapping change and retain their logs for audit. Also sending them a reissued invite after config change to confirm success.

Related: DocuSign NDA for vendor onboarding was sent earlier (link below), no PII exchanged in these emails besides the logs.

Attachments: coupa-invite-log.txt, sso-screenshot.png
Related links: Jira SUP-4321, https://app.coupa.com/invite/abc123, DocuSign: https://docusign.net/xyz
